Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly shifted the conclusion to Treasury Today’s “Adam Smith Awards,” conflating a corporate awards program with the academic “Adam Smith Prize” at Cambridge. This misinterpretation ignored the authoritative Cambridge sources already surfaced (econ.cam.ac.uk) that explicitly state the Adam Smith Prize is awarded by the University of Cambridge’s Faculty of Economics via the Adam Smith Prize Endowment Fund. The erroneous disambiguation and premature finalization led directly to the wrong awarding body.
